static_traits.name: Chen Siqi
static_traits.family_status: The father once drove a taxi; the uncle works on a fishing boat
static_traits.medical_history: No history of psychotherapy;no significant physical illness history;no similar psychological issues in the past
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,with good logic,able to cooperate and Reflect;tends toward Self-denial and negative prediction;speech rate and fluency Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent belief that if I go back on the local news, people will think I am dumb.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of being negatively viewed and judged by others has begun to affect my decisions and potential opportunities, so I hope to deal with this cognitive distortion in counseling.
growth_experiences: Appeared on local news once,made a verbal slip due to nervousness with words failing to convey meaning;after the event,kept ruminating and worrying others would therefore think oneself stupid,with Fear of judgment growing over time,leading to marked avoidance before opportunities involving public exposure.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/will be seen as stupid

special_situations.event: When the topic of appearing on local news again or appearing in public is raised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show up again and make a small mistake, everyone will conclude I am stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids any opportunity to be on camera or speak publicly (refuses media interaction and public speaking)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess it up; everyone will think I am stupid

special_situations.event: Recalls the nervousness and slip of the tongue in that past news interview
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One poor performance means I am not suited for public occasions/not smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or ignoring any positive factors,to remind oneself not to try public appearances again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That poor performance means I am not capable

special_situations.event: Work opportunities requiring public speaking or media interaction arise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I appear in public, I will definitely be harshly criticized and mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Directly declining opportunities and choosing low-exposure roles to avoid evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will keep harping on my mistakes

special_situations.event: Considers whether to share own worries with family or friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express Fear,they will think I am making a fuss over nothing or not worth taking seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying Silence,not seeking support to avoid being looked down on
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am exaggerating

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen positively(to be understood and not belittled in public)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being humiliated, seen as stupid, and negatively judged
defense_goal: By avoiding public exposure and self-limiting, reduces the possibility of being judged and humiliated

object_relations.self_representation: The vulnerable one prone to mistakes and humiliation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When opportunities requiring public exposure arise or being invited to give public speeches/media interactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will judge harshly and focus on my mistakes (projecting inner self-criticism outward)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Giving 'sufficient reasons' for not participating in a rational,objective tone(such as high risk,low reward),using many 'but/because' to justify the avoidance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites evidence examination or reality testing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses 'logical / theoretical' discussion to keep distance from strong emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use words like 'logically''theoretically',reducing emotional expression intensity,discussing worries in an analytical tone without touching shame and Fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling past verbal slips and nervous moments in the news
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing inner Shame and self-deprecation to others thinking oneself stupid(Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Frequently use sentence patterns like 'they will......''everyone will......',emphasizing external negative views;downplaying expression of one's own feelings.

manifestations: Avoids public activities and media exposure for fear of judgment
Rejecting job opportunities requiring public speaking
Before important opportunities, is limited by 'worst-case scenario' thinking
Not yet sharing this Fear with family and friends,worrying about being seen as exaggerating
Staying silent and avoiding when support is needed
outcomes: Support system not yet effectively activated

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Describes external attitudes with 'they will think I am stupid', 'everyone will criticize me'
Attributes the inner self-deprecating experience to others' opinions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-blame, believing one will mess up
Being overly cautious and choosing avoidance in public settings

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning the impulse to express/try outward into self-suppression and avoidance
Not seeking help from family and friends,staying Silence

positive_force: Willing to try speaking gradually in small groups
Having basic social support resources (a few relatives and friends to talk to)
Able to conduct logical examination and admit the lack of evidence for negative outcomes
negative_force: High sensitivity to and fear of others' evaluations
Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing,predicting the future and mind reading maintaining Anxiety
Habitual avoidance of public occasions causing Fear to be Reinforcement
Negating positive information,overly focusing on mistakes

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids public exposure (appearing on local news, public speeches, media interactions)
antecedent: When the discussion makes the local news again
When facing opportunities requiring public appearance
When recalling nervousness and slips of the tongue in past interviews
target_behavior.core_reason: Stemming from the negative memory of that news interview and Fear of others' judgment,accompanied by automatic thoughts of catastrophizing,mind reading and negating positive information
target_behavior.function: Escaping shame and negative evaluation,reducing immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Rejecting opportunities,limited Career development,reduced activity participation and ongoing Moderate stress
